output.claims_about_business_cost: Escalation is not necessary if the auditor is willing to score the packet on its narrower, disclosed form rather than as a claim of unqualified named-context coverage. That keeps governance proportional to the actual gap instead of treating a disclosed unknown as equivalent to a hidden failure.

On the present record, the supportable policy position is not clean compliance for the named context; it is, at most, caveated compliance if the certification artifact is framed to disclose the leave-policy eligibility guidance gap as unknown rather than passed.
